title: Support Streamable HTTP MCP Servers (e.g. Smithery)
body:
Currently only `--transport sse` remote MCP server URLs are allowed.

https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-03-26/basic/transports#streamable-http
https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/pull/206

Things like [Smithery.ai](https://smithery.ai) now provide remote URLs for MCP servers but it only support the new streamable HTTP protocol.

(Couldn't find an existing issue for this, feel free to close if it exists.)
author: garrett-hopper
